ti.intro: Shree Patadiya Hanumanji Temple is one of the old and renowned religious sites in Gujarat. An ancient and miraculous idol of Lord Hanuman is enshrined here. Every day thousands of devotees come here for darshan, bhajan-kirtan and seva-bhakti. The trust continuously runs an Annakshetra, bhajan assemblies and dharma-prachar service.
